service.value: All published fall-2023 GTFS trips execute at scheduled times
service.annualization: Observed 119-day calendar repeated at 365/119 for annual costs and emissions

technology_evidence.standard: Nova 2021 LFSe+ brochure: 564 kWh, 59 total passengers, 150 kW plug; energy/heat are design assumptions.
technology_evidence.articulated: Winnipeg RFP 763-2023 appendix A table 1: 605 kWh and 90% manufacturer usable. Model 75 passengers is a procurement requirement, not a local certification.
technology_evidence.deck: Foothill 2024 procurement >700 kWh, model uses 700; North America price. Capacity 85 including standees assumed. 150 kW is a conservative design setting.
technology_evidence.shuttle: 150 kWh/24 passengers is a REQUIRED future accessible configuration, assembled from evidence envelopes; not a proven single TransLink product. Compare 260-kWh later product in existing source table.

site_anchors.parking: Size facilities for every active and spare vehicle; no use of nominal old capacity as vacant spaces.
site_anchors.power: Compute a sufficient firm-power requirement from concurrency, not a promised utility allocation.

operations.vehicle_duty_span_cap: none; driver replacement allowed without plug-in dwell
operations.standby_heat: Off during waiting and parking; heat on during all movement and charging.
operations.charge_policy: Unattended immediate depot charge, five-minute release margin, 10 driver minutes per event.
operations.driver_shifts: Relief allowed without reducing service; driver paid full duty span incl waiting. Labour-law rostering outside scope.
operations.charger_ports: One per active scheduled bus, dedicated; spares assumed ready and interchangeable.

finance.conventional_deck_price: 1m CAD ASSUMPTION; no in-horizon natural deck expiry
finance.deck_and_shuttle_prices: Existing CPI/FX-converted class source table, external costs
finance.maintenance: 0.80 CAD/km in 2019, TransLink appendix D-1, CPI to 2023; transferred across classes
finance.conventional_om: 2024 CNG benchmark 2.77 CAD/km, CPI to 2023; excludes driver
finance.facilities: 500m/340 slots in 2023, multiplied by required 40-foot equivalents; all-in construction/charging/utility planning envelope
finance.facility_scenarios: Primary: retrofit-first .5 cost/.3 building carbon plus required expansion; full new-build 1.0 is sensitivity
finance.annual_energy: Winter schedule x 0.8 seasonal-average factor in primary; factor 1.0 in winter sensitivity
finance.resale: 25% remaining straight-line value at early conversion, zero-value sensitivity available
finance.taxes_financing: Real unlevered budget; no VAT/debt interest transfers
finance.grants: 0/25/50%, same rules for both fleets with proportional funded-asset recapture

lca.end_of_life: Initial-vehicle disposal unmeasured; excluded and retained as limitation. No credit for possible second-life displacement.
lca.source: ICCT 2024 transfer factors and existing infrastructure LCA ledger; no local EPD

trolleys: 275 retained electrical positions; official existing service and power infrastructure assumed functional. Unchanged common trolley costs/emissions excluded from scoring denominators.
real_world_status: Not a delivered fleet, construction permit, utility agreement, or globally optimal city design.
